Compare responses from multiple LLM models

| Port | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

## What it emits

| Port | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Results (`results`) | `json` | — | Comparison results from all models |
| Fastest Response (`fastest`) | `text` | — | Response from fastest model |

| Option | Type | Default | What it does |

| `models` | array | [] | Models to compare. Empty = the workflow's own default provider/model (tier aliases like $medium resolve through AI Defaults, #4325). |
